js: 'SETUP: a dev instance whose database has a decision row decide/laya (backend cpu; labs-store design §7.2), started with LMGW_DATA_DIR=<scratch> scripts/dev-instance.sh 127.0.0.1:8897. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/decision-lab.json --base http://127.0.0.1:8897 --token-file <scratch>.token --podman-guard "" --shots <dir>. The guard is off because the drive asks decide/laya, which starts its CPU container (and no other). It deletes the Decision lab history of that instance first, asks Ticket triage as written, perturbed and through an override with two options swapped, reads the JSONL and CSV exports back, deletes one group, reloads, and clears the lab. Then: a group with a typed image (data:image/x-receipt;…) opened in the form, its preview and Edit as JSON keeping the kept image as lab-artifact:<id>, re-asked (Laya reads no images: 501) with the URL as first typed; a double-clicked Ask asking once; an open Raw surviving another group’s cells; an Ask the model filter would hide clearing it; a switch of the head model to decide/kev-4b (never asked, never counted) clearing the gauge; the results head whole at 1024; and the history cleared again.'
